schemeScope: Combined Paper 1 and Paper 2 scheme. PDF 16 reading marking instructions; 17–19 Léamhthuiscint A; 20–23 Léamhthuiscint B; 24 the literature Gaeilge note, 2A (both prescribed texts and their shared Treoir) and the 2B film alternative; 25 the film’s one-trait note and the 2B play alternative; 26–27 poetry 3A and 3B; 28 Ceist 4 Treoracha (4A–4E print no text of their own) and 4F; 29 the general grading table for every total, then modified marking (SMM). PDF 1–15 belong to Paper 1; 30–31 are blank and 32 empty.
reviewMethod: Every paper page (1 cover, 2 a pointer to the instructions, 3 instructions, 11 the 4F poem Colmáin, 12 blank) and every applicable scheme page read in the text layer and checked against the printed page; each prompt and scheme slice is asserted against the PDFs by the builder.

nonPoolDecisions: Reading (2015: Léamhthuiscint A and B both compulsory): all twelve questions of both passages are carded as whole questions; each printed part is also a practice card at its published tariff. A 1(b)(ii) and B 2(b)(i) (“{1 mharc + 1 mharc}”) and A 5(b)(i) (“{2 mharc} (2 phointe eolais) {1 mharc + 1 mharc}”) price two independent one-mark answers and expose one-mark slots; every (a) part of Q1–5 (2 mharc + 1 mharc) and both 6(a) stay whole as 0/2/3.

A 6(b) prices an opinion 2 and two reasons with an example each (Cúis 2 + Sampla 3 = 5, twice); B 6(b) the genre 2 and two traits with an example each (Tréith 2 + Sampla 3 = 5, twice). The 5s are accepted only with the opinion or the correctly named genre, so neither 6(b) is split into practice slots (the 2017 B 6(b) shape). Both must be in the candidate’s own words.
Single-answer parts allow only the mark values the scheme prints for them (0, the printed partials and the full tariff).

Prose: 2A prints two prescribed texts (the film Cáca Milis or the play An Lasair Choille), a card each as in 2018; 2B prints an optional film or an optional play, one card carrying both alternatives. Poetry 3A (Colscaradh) and 3B (an optional modern poem) and the six Q4 options are one card each; the optional text itself is open content chosen inside one route.

2B is one card for two printed alternatives the scheme prices differently (the film “Tréithe agus Léiriú (25)”, capped at 14 where one trait is discussed; the play “Príomhthéama (2) = Forbairt (23)”). Its Eolas criterion is one 25-mark judgement led by the scheme’s choice line, with both pricings in its guidance; a single criterion cannot carry alternative splits.
sourceFindings: Paper 2 = 200: Ceist 1 Léamhthuiscint A 50 + B 50 (Q1–5 at 7 = (a) 3 + (b)(i) 2 + (b)(ii) 2; Q6 at 15 = (a) 3 + (b) 12); Ceist 2 Prós 30 (25 Eolas + 5 Gaeilge); Ceist 3 Filíocht 30 (25 + 5); Ceist 4 Litríocht Bhreise 40 (35 + 5).

General grade-to-mark table: PDF 29 (scheme page 27), “Grádú Marcála sna Ceisteanna”, after Ceist 4 and before modified marking. It prints grades A–D for every total from 200 down to 5 under the note “Den bhfíorthábhacht é go mbeifeá ag machnamh i ngráid agus i gcéatadáin le linn na marcála. (Féach an scéim ghrádaithe sa Cheapadóireacht ar lgh. 11-13.)”; it names no question and heads no section. Nothing ties it to a particular question beyond its position after Ceist 4 and its pointer to the composition grading; it is carried as printed on the literature cards (Gaeilge, and the judged Eolas criteria), never read for rows.

Literature: the scheme prints no band tables and no supporting notes for 2A (one Treoir for both texts, priced only by the closing note “Ní mór don Scrúdaitheoir an marc ar eolas as 25 marc …”), none for 4A–4E (the Ceist 4 Treoracha: “an t-eolas a mharcáil as 35 marc agus an Ghaeilge san iarracht a mheas as 5 mharc”).

2B prices its alternatives differently: the film “Tréithe agus Léiriú (25)” with “Mura bhfuil ach plé agus léiriú ar thréith amháin de chuid an phríomhcharachtair, marcáil an t-eolas as 14 mharc” (PDF 25), the play “Príomhthéama (2) = Forbairt (23)”.

Paper vs scheme: 3A and 3B print (i) 15, (ii) 6, (iii) 9 and the scheme assesses Eolas 13 (3B: 2 + 11), 5 (1 + 4) and 7 (1 + 2 + 2 + 2); 4F prints (i) 20, (ii) 10, (iii) 10 and the scheme assesses Eolas 19 (2 + 17), Míniú 8 and 8 (2 + 3 + 3); the remaining 5 is the shared Gaeilge award.

A 5(b)(i) prints two tariffs, “{2 mharc} (2 phointe eolais) {1 mharc + 1 mharc}”, over one answer carrying both points (“Léirigh na scannáin seo dóibh go raibh saol difriúil agus saoirse ann lasmuigh den Chóiré Thuaidh = 2 mharc”); carded as two one-mark slots.

Scheme misprints kept as printed in the guidance: A 1(a) answer “as gach cearn den domhain” (the passage: “domhan”); A 4(b)(i) reprint “Cén socrú ata déanta” (the paper: “atá”); B 1(b)(ii) reprint “tráchtáirí” and “(Alt1)” (the paper: “tráchtairí”, “(Alt 1)”); B 5(b)(ii)’s answers read “go bhfuilimid ag geallúint ‘cearta cothroma agus deiseanna cothroma’” where the passage prints “go bhfuilimid dílis d’aidhm Fhorógra na Poblachta a gheallann ‘cearta cothroma agus deiseanna cothroma’”; the Ceist 4 Treoracha read “usáid” (úsáid) and the heading “(A, B, C D, E nó F)” (a comma missing; the paper prints “(A, B, C, D, E nó F)”). The card questions are the paper’s.
The scheme’s bullets (SymbolMT U+F0B7) are read as “•”.
